params.amount: Amount of tokenIn to deposit (in tokenIn decimals).
params.tokenIn: Token the caller is depositing. Pass WETH_ADDR to deposit WETH directly.

returns.shares: Liquid-token shares minted to the caller.

returns._0: The idle balance in WETH equivalent
The address that users need to approve for withdrawals
True if vault is approved for the amount
True if position is in range, false otherwise

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingUniswapFees(address).details: Exact only when shares only change via this vault. Peer transfers of `liquidToken` desync debt.

recordPoolValueSnapshot().details: Callable only by `FloatKeeper` (per manager). Demeter triggers via `FloatKeeper.snapshotVaultPoolValue()`.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

rescueToken(address,address).details: Only owner can rescue tokens. Cannot rescue asset or liquid token as they are part of the vault.

params._recipient: Address to send the rescued tokens to
params._token: Address of the token to rescue

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.shares: Number of liquidToken shares to withdraw

returns.assets: WETH value of withdrawn shares (strategy returns WETH directly to receiver)

available().notice: Get available WETH balance in vault (for deposits)

availableAsset().notice: Get available ASSET balance in vault

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposit tokens into the vault. If tokenIn is not WETH it is swapped to WETH         via the Uniswap UniversalRouter before being forwarded to the strategy.

depositETH().notice: Wrap native ETH to WETH and mint shares (same accounting as a direct WETH `deposit`).

getApproval(address).notice: Get current approval amount from owner to vault

getIdleBalance().notice: Get the idle balance (tokens not in pool)

getPoolBalance().notice: Get the balance of tokens in the pool

getPoolValueSnapshotCount().notice: Number of stored pool value snapshots (newest at index `length - 1`).

getPositionDetails().notice: Get detailed position information from Uniswap V3

getVaultAddress().notice: Helper function to get the vault address for approvals

hasApproval(address,uint256).notice: Check if user has approved vault to spend their liquid tokens

isInRange().notice: Check if the position is currently in range

pendingUniswapFees(address).notice: WETH-notional fees attributed to this account vs `uniswapFeeDebt` (simulates pending sync).

rescueToken(address,address).notice: Rescue ERC20 tokens sent to the contract by mistake

syncUniswapFees().notice: Pulls new `UniswapFeesCollected` into `accUniswapFeesPerShare` using current total supply.
